name: std::ranges::take_view<V>::sentinel<Const>::sentinel
intro:
Constructs a sentinel.

1) Default constructor. Value-initializes the underlying sentinel.

2) Initializes the underlying sentinel with end.

3) Conversion from /*sentinel*/<false> to /*sentinel*/<true>. Move constructs corresponding members.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
end

 -

 a sentinel representing the end of (possibly const-qualified) V


 s

 -

 a /*sentinel*/<false>
